cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) infants admitted to Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital between January 1, 2017, and December 31, 2018
finding: The overall survival rate of VLBW infants was 66.5%, with better survival associated with antenatal steroid use, antenatal care, cesarean section delivery, female sex, resuscitation at birth, and a 5-minute Apgar score greater than five.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with better survival to discharge in VLBW infants.
